title: Age-related changes in Biomechanics of Lower and upper Extremities
summary:
Many older people lose mobility and motor stability with increasing age. This can restrict their independence, increase the risk of falls, and significantly diminish their quality of life. At the same time, comprehensive scientific data is currently lacking to accurately understand and effectively prevent age-related changes in movement. Our study aims to expand this knowledge and create the foundation for better methods of early detection, prevention, and rehabilitation.
We record the movements of younger and older people in the lab using sensors and a 3D camera system. Based on this data, we will create a large reference database that enables researchers, with the help of artificial intelligence, to better understand movement problems and effectively prevent them.
conditions: Diseases of the musculoskeletal system and connective tissue
